author: pgaudet
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete non-enantiomer-specific cysteine metabolic process terms 
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31281 

GO:0006534 cysteine metabolic process (10 EXP)
GO:0019267 L-asparagine biosynthetic process from L-cysteine (0 annotation)
GO:0019452 taurine biosynthetic process from L-cysteine (1 EXP)
GO:0006535 L-cysteine biosynthetic process from L-serine (18 EXP)
GO:0019343 L-cysteine biosynthetic process via L-cystathionine (4 EXP)
GO:0019345 L-cysteine biosynthetic process via S-sulfo-L-cysteine (9 EXP)
GO:1901494 regulation of cysteine metabolic process 


Annotations are here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1qnAgXhrhQgw8egikPaMZA-4WBIbDmOYPgkBKMOOz578/edit?gid=0#gid=0


Impacted groups: 
GeneDB	3
MGI	8
ComplexPortal	3
EcoCyc	6
EcoliWiki	1
Reactome	3


For others, annotations will be remapped automatically: 
PomBase
TAIR
UniProt
WB
BHF-UCL
SGD
MGI
CAFA


Thanks, Pascale
title: Review annotations to non-enantiomer-specific cysteine metabolic process terms
